tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List every golf course on the TeeStrike marketplace with its rack rate, location, and number of open tee time auctions.

maxRackRate.description: Only return courses whose rack rate per player is at or below this dollar amount.

tools.name: get_course
tools.title: Get course details
tools.description: Get the full profile of one TeeStrike course: description, designer, yardage, par, amenities, rack rate, and its auction date.

course.description: Course name (partial match allowed) or numeric course id.

tools.name: list_tee_times
tools.title: List tee time auctions
tools.description: List live tee time auctions with current bid, bid count, group size, and time remaining. Filter by course, group size, or how soon the auction closes.

course.description: Course name (partial match allowed) or id. Omit to search all courses.

players.description: Only slots for this group size.

closingWithinHours.description: Only auctions closing within this many hours.

maxBid.description: Only auctions whose current bid per player is at or below this.

tools.name: estimate_bid_cost
tools.title: Estimate bid cost
tools.description: Estimate the all-in cost of a TeeStrike bid: per-player bid, TeeStrike's 14% buyer's premium, group total, and how the bid compares to the course rack rate and the current leading bid.

course.description: Course name (partial match allowed) or numeric course id.

bidPerPlayer.description: Proposed bid amount per player, in dollars.

players.description: Number of players in the group.

time.description: Optional tee time (e.g. '7:14 AM') to compare against that slot's leading bid.
